items.titleEn: Prisoner Doctor Hussam Abu Safiah wins the Arab Doctor Award for 2026
items.summaryEn: Palestinian prisoner physician Hussam Idris Abu Safiya won the Arab Doctor Award for 2026 in the field of "Medical Endurance", awarded by the Arab Council of Ministers of Health, during its sixty-fifth session, on Tuesday, at the headquarters of the General Secretariat of the League of Nations.

items.titleEn: Seven killed and wounded by Israeli shelling in the Gaza Strip .
items.summaryEn: The Israeli occupation forces on Tuesday continued to violate the ceasefire agreement in the Gaza Strip, with artillery shelling, gunfire and targeting fishermen in the open sea.

items.title: 15 أسيراً من غزة بسجون الاحتلال يتنسمون الحرية
items.summary: أفرجت سلطات الاحتلال الإسرائيلي، الثلاثاء، عن 15 أسيراً من قطاع غزة، بعد فترات اعتقال متفاوتة، ونقلتهم حافلات تابعة للجنة الدولية للصليب الأحمر عبر معبر كرم أبو سالم إلى مجمع ناصر الطبي في مدينة خانيونس، جنوبي القطاع.
items.titleEn: Fifteen prisoners from Gaza in the occupation prisons are breathing freedom.
items.summaryEn: The Israeli occupation authorities released 15 detainees from the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, after various detention periods, and transported them by buses of the International Committee of the Red Cross through the Karim Abu Salem crossing to the Nasser medical complex in the city of Khanyones, south of the sector.

items.titleEn: The Israeli opposition is agreeing to distribute the seats in the Knesset and is moving to remove its president.
items.summaryEn: The Israeli opposition parties agreed on Tuesday to distribute leadership positions in the 26th Knesset, as part of their moves to form a united political front and change the leadership of the parliament, concurrent with their efforts to form a new government and dissolve the coalition.

items.title: لافروف: إسرائيل لا تنفذ خطة ترامب بشأن غزة وترفض إقامة دولة فلسطينية
items.summary: اتهم وزير الخارجية الروسي سيرغي لافروف، الثلاثاء، إسرائيل بعدم تنفيذ خطة الرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترامب بشأن قطاع غزة، مشيراً إلى أن تل أبيب تعلن صراحة رفضها حتى التفكير في إقامة دولة فلسطينية.
items.titleEn: Lavrov: Israel is not implementing Trump's plan for Gaza and refuses to establish a Palestinian state
items.summaryEn: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov on Tuesday accused Israel of not implementing US President Donald Trump's plan for the Gaza Strip, noting that Tel Aviv has explicitly declined even to consider establishing a Palestinian state.
